As a bonus action, you can spend one minute in a frenetic stance. While in the stance, the first time each turn you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, that creature has disadvantage on the next melee attack roll it makes against you before the start of your next turn. If that creature is also within 5 feet of you, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier) or be pushed back 5 feet, letting you immediately move into the space it left without provoking opportunity attacks.

The stance ends early if you're incapacitated or killed. You must finish a long rest before using this feature again.
